Del Mar, California · eat

Restaurants in Del Mar for cyclists

Where to eat in Del Mar the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

For: Belgian Waffle Ride California.

Restaurants in Del Mar for cyclists, listed

  1. Jake's Del Mar

    Coastal seafood · 1660 Coast Blvd, Del Mar, CA 92014

    On the beach in the village; brunch through dinner.

  2. Pacifica Del Mar

    Seafood · 1555 Camino Del Mar, Del Mar, CA 92014

    Village seafood house for more than 30 years; casual enough for post-ride.

  3. Sbicca

    California · 215 15th St, Del Mar, CA 92014

    Rooftop with ocean views, a block off Camino Del Mar.

  4. Brigantine Seafood & Oyster Bar

    Seafood and oysters · 3263 Camino Del Mar, Del Mar, CA 92014

    At the north end of town near the fairgrounds; big enough for a group.

  5. Viewpoint Brewing Co.

    Brewpub · 2201 San Dieguito Dr, Suite D, Del Mar, CA 92014

    Brewery and full menu on the river next to the fairgrounds, the closest food to the BWR polo fields.
